shortDescription: By Junko FujitaJapan's five-year government bond yield fell on Thursday as investors awaited the outcome of an auction of bonds with the same maturity, with the Bank of Japan's rate-hike cycle already priced in.Here are a few details:

children: Japan's five-year government bond yield fell on Thursday as investors awaited the outcome of an auction of bonds with the same maturity, with the Bank of Japan's rate-hike cycle already priced in.
The five-year JGB yield (JP5YTN=JBTC) fell 1.5 basis points (bps) to 2.175%. The 10-year JGB yield (JP10YTN=JBTC) slipped 3 bps to 2.76%
The Ministry of Finance will announce the outcome of the five-year bond auction later in the day
"The auction may draw decent demand because the upside potential for the five-year bond yield is limited," said Takashi Fujiwara, lead fund manager at Resona Asset Management
The market for overnight index swaps indicates the OIS is at around 1.75% in June next year, signalling that the market has priced in the BOJ's rate-hike path to end around that time, said Fujiwara

Earlier in the day, dovish BOJ policymaker Toichiro Asada pushed back against calls within the board for a near-term interest rate hike, arguing that premature rate hikes could hurt growth and push down underlying inflation
Market analysts said his comments were within expectations, therefore did not move yields in the morning
The 30-year bond yield (JP30YTN=JBTC) fell 4.5 bps to 3.895%
